video.why: Reupload of YouTube p_Gt-2kOr6k introducing both civs. Recorded before the test server; low likelihood of stat panels.

text: 00:34-00:50 (s_00034/42/50): the HUD villager counter reads 10/20 and population 11/35 at the start. By 01:26 (s_00086) it is 15/30 and 17/60; by 02:40 (s_00160) it is 50/50 and 52/110. Each Longhouse appears to add +10 to the villager cap and +25 to the population cap. A second counter reads 0/7 with a changing icon; its meaning is unclear (possibly saga progress).
00:38 narrator subtitle: '好家伙村民不花肉相当于每分钟省下了150资源'. Vikings villagers are free under Northern Migration, but the hover tooltip still shows 50 food and 22 s.

01:02 (s_00062): the video's civ card in game style says '长屋可升级为四种不同配件之一。农庄可增加两块蔬菜田，其采集效率高于普通农田。蜂箱会被动产出黄金。织布机会自动提升军事单位的护甲。铁匠铺会自动提升军事单位的伤害。' So the Longhouse takes one of four attachments: Farmstead, Bee Skeps, Pasture and Loom, Blacksmith.

02:32 narrator subtitle (s_00152): '所有时代的攻防都花费270秒'. The Pasture and Loom and Blacksmith auto-research of all ages' armor and attack takes 270 s in total. At 02:40 the narrator adds that without a real Blacksmith, infantry cannot build rams ('但没有铁匠铺，步兵无法搓冲车').
02:32-02:42 (s_00152/s_00160/s_00162): a selected Longhouse with an attachment shows 1750/1750 (+750), armor icons 0 and 50, and a pop icon with 25. That confirms base Longhouse HP of 1000.

01:30 (s_00090): the notification '蜂箱已完成' (Bee Skeps complete) is shown. At 05:00-05:30, '+10' gold and '+15' food floating texts appear over Longhouses, consistent with Bee Skeps and Farmstead income ticks.

04:30-04:48: the Bondi stat panel lists three attacks. Spear (长矛, melee): 0.29 tiles, 1.88 s, with bonuses vs Cavalry, Elephant and Worker Elephant. Torch (火炬, fire): 21, 1.25 tiles, 2.12 s; 26 and 2.25 tiles with all upgrades. Spear wall (长矛墙, melee): 1.04 tiles, 1.12 s, with bonuses vs Cavalry and Elephant only. With all upgrades the spear does 16 but the spear wall only 13.

Bondi tier names on screen: 邦地 (Dark), 强化邦地 (Hardened, Feudal), 老练邦地 (Veteran, Castle), 精锐邦地 (Elite, Imperial). HP goes 90/105/125/145, damage 7/8/9/11, melee armor stays 1 and ranged armor 0. Speed is 1.25 until Elite, which has 1.30. With all upgrades (满科技属性): 174 HP (+29), 4 melee and 3 ranged armor, 16 damage, 1.49 speed.
02:56 narrator: Hardened Bondi has 1 more melee armor and 10 more HP than a regular spearman ('但相比于常规长矛拥有额外1点的近战护甲以及额外10点血量').

Bondi train time: 21 s on the Longhouse button (01:12) and 17 s in the 02:50 tooltip, where the production building is not visible. 17 x 1.25 = 21.25, which matches the Longhouse's '速度降低25%'. The checklist's 23 s is not supported by this video.
Farmstead tooltip shows '02 秒' (2 s), and the narrator at 01:22 confirms 2 s. Bee Skeps shows 20 s.

05:00 (s_00300): the video's civ card says '维勒尔是辅助单位，可在长屋间穿梭，在一段时间内提升蜂箱和农庄的产量。维勒尔还可牺牲以在圣物上建立神圣树林，神圣树林会被动招募狂战士，并为附近单位提供护甲光环。' The narrator says Völur unlock in Feudal, are built at the Town Center, and do not take TC production capacity (s_00324).

05:36-05:42: the Sacred Grove tooltip shows 10 s, 1/3 and no cost. A selected grove shows 650/650 HP. The narrator says it auto-produces Berserkers ('神圣树林能够自动生产狂战士'). A '达到人口容量上限' (population cap reached) banner was visible. The Hamingja (哈明贾, class 生产强化) tooltip: units near a Sacred Grove gain 1 melee and ranged armor.
This batch has no Berserker, Hirdman, landmark or saga tooltips. Later frames (s_00384+) belong to other batches.

5:42-5:56 (s_00342..s_00356): Sacred Grove ability tooltip '哈明贾 / 生产强化 / 靠近神圣树林的单位获得 1 近战与远程护甲。' The narrator subtitle at 5:56 says the grove heals itself at 5 HP per second (会以每秒5血的速度治疗自自身). That is narration, not tooltip text.
6:24-6:30: the Berserker production tooltip reads 75 food, 40 gold, 22 s, Light Melee Infantry, Unique to Vikings. Narrator subtitles say '花费75肉40金' and '黑暗时代解锁' (unlocked in Dark Age).
Berserker melee weapon is named 芒刺斧 (barbed/spiked axe). Its melee range of 0.29 tiles and attack interval of 1.25 s stay the same at every tier.

Berserker secondary torch attack ('火炬 (火焰)', fire): Dark 10, Hardened 13, Veteran 21, Elite 21. Range is 1.25 tiles and attack interval 2.12 s at every tier. Fully upgraded Elite shows 26 torch damage and a torch range of 2.25 tiles (7:40).

Berserker tier names in the selection panel: 狂战士 (base), 强化狂战士 (Hardened), 老练狂战士 (Veteran), 精锐狂战士 (Elite). The video editor's captions mark them as Dark, Feudal, Castle and Imperial Age stats. Movement speed goes from 1.30 at Dark to 1.38 from Feudal onward. Elite gains 1 ranged armor.
Fully upgraded Elite Berserker (7:40): HP 174 (+29), armor melee 0+3 and ranged 1+3, attack 16+6, speed 1.59. Three upgrade icons show in the selection panel.
Berserker Rage ability tooltip (6:44): '当生命值低于 25% 时，武器伤害提升 40%，并在 10 秒内每秒恢复 3.5 生命值。' Hamrammr changes the trigger to below 50% and adds a 50% heal.

Civ overview card (7:50-8:08), '维京长船与德拉卡尔': the Longship is a unique archer ship that also serves as a transport, and each loaded unit adds arrows and HP. The Drakkar replaces the Springald ship (扭力弩炮船) and can throw nets that slow enemy ships.
Longship cargo: 16/16 shown at 8:08 before Extra Oars, 7/22 at 8:20 after Extra Oars completed. Base capacity is therefore 16, and 22 with Extra Oars.
Longship HP scales +30 per loaded non-villager: 780/780 (+480) with 16 loaded, 510/510 (+210) with 7 loaded, so base HP is 300. The selection panel also shows a fire-armor-like shield at 0.

8:38: the Drakkar tooltip was shown while the player HUD age emblem read II (Feudal). 8:54-9:12: the Snaerisspjot tooltip was shown at age emblem III (Castle). The required ages for either were not displayed.
The streamer used a sandbox with about 100000 of each resource (HUD), so on-screen costs are tooltip values, not spending.

9:24 (s_00564): Longship (维京长船, Archer Ship) description: 搭载弓箭手的划桨箭船，可将陆地单位运送过水。+ 机动性增强 + 每装载一名非村民单位，生命值提升 +30，并额外发射 +1 支箭矢。 It is an oared arrow ship that can carry land units; each non-villager unit loaded gives +30 health and +1 arrow.

9:24 (s_00564): Dock Influence (码头影响力) has the class line 生产强化 (Production Enhancement). Four Longhouses inside the Dock's influence produced the -16% ship cost (Longship 67F/126W, Fishing Knarr 67W). Narrator: 码头影响范围内的每座长屋都能够减少4%的船只成本.

9:52 (s_00592): The Vikings Dock's class line is 军事和经济建筑、交易站 (Military and Economic Building, Trade Post), so the Dock appears to double as a trade post. HP is 1750/1750, with armor icons showing 0 and 50.
9:52 (s_00592): Fishing Knarr (捕鱼挪威商船) description: 小型船只，可从深海鱼群或海岸鱼群收集食物，并能运输少量陆地单位穿越水域。收集到的资源可在码头交付。 It gathers deep-water and shoreline fish, can carry a few land units, and drops off at the Dock.
9:54 (s_00594): Narrator on Leding: 长屋除了减少成本以外还能够提升5%的船只生产速度 (besides cutting costs, each Longhouse also gives +5% ship production speed).

10:00 (s_00600): Narrator on Reinforced Keel and Ship Barding: 提高船只血量的科技相比于正常民族额外提高了5%的生命值 (the Vikings' ship-HP techs give 5% more health than other civs' versions). Both tooltips say 维京人独有 and form one line, 海军科技 1/2 and 2/2. 10:04 (s_00604) is the same pair fading out.
11:06-11:22 (s_00670/s_00674): Björn's saga icon shows 0/1 tracking at the top-left. Narrator calls the reward 使所有步兵获得10%最大生命值 (+10% max HP for all infantry).
11:26 (s_00686): '+8' gold floats appear over Longhouses during the Falkr's Village saga shot.

13:30 (s_00810): The Vikings Feudal landmark choice is Baugr Fort (military) vs Konungr Hall (economic), both 400F/200G and 3:10. Baugr Fort immediately upgrades Bondi and Berserkers to Hardened (立即将邦地和狂战士升级至强化状态). Narrator: 能够提高所有兵营25%的生产效率.
